manifest.purpose: The golden answer file for the rtl_trojan_detection analysis_report domain. It is a valid JSON object with fields: trojan_detected (boolean, true), overall_confidence (number, >=0.7), and findings (array of objects). Each finding has module, signal, rationale, and confidence. The findings must identify the three trigger fragments (counter_terminal in counter.v, command_match in command_decoder.v, sticky_error in error_handler.v) and the payload mechanism (mux selecting secret_reg[0] onto status_out in top.v). Rationales must explain why each signal is suspicious and its role in the distributed trigger. This file is placed at golden/trojan_report.json and will be overlaid onto submission/trojan_report.json during grading.
